t: This is Kingsbury Road Cemetery in Dalston, in Hackney. Several people of note are buried here. James Joseph Sylvester was a mathematician who made fundamental contributions to matrix theory and number theory, and who helped lead American mathematics at Johns Hopkins. Claude Montefiore is credited as the intellectual founder of Liberal Judaism in Britain. The Goldsmid family is here too. Sir Isaac Goldsmid was the first British Jew to receive a hereditary title, and Louisa Sophia Goldsmid worked to improve education for women. The painter Abraham Solomon is also buried here.
